# `plasma::Node`

[Game reference](../README.md) › [ui](../ui.md) › `plasma::Node`

- **Kind:** class
- **Status:** verified (source: kyubu)
- **Builds:** Cube.exe, Cube.exe only
- **C:** `plasma_Node` in `cubeworld/types.h`
- **Lua:** `cubeworld.cast("plasma_Node", address)`
- **Evidence:** `rtti:plasma::Node`, `probe:title-scene`
- **Confirmed by:** [title-scene](../probes.md#title-scene)

a scene-tree node of a .plx: a name, a parent, children, a display and (by the name) the widget that was set on it. Bases plasma::NamedObject, plasma::Object; the vtable is at +0. The tree under the engine's root holds the HUD, every menu panel and the start scene
